headline: Falcons place cornerback A.J. Terrell on IR with groin injury
summary: The Falcons placed star cornerback A.J. Terrell on injured reserve Tuesday with a groin injury, the team announced.

headline: Jets, QB Will Levis Agree To Deal
summary: Will Levis saw his Titans tenure come to an end last month. He managed to line up a Jets workout in short order, though, and an agreement is now in place. Levis is signing with New York, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer reports. This will be a practice squad pact, he adds. Levis joined Jack Plummer in auditioning […]

headline: Rams' McVay unsure about Nacua's status for Week 3 vs. Broncos
summary: Sean McVay said he doesn't know wide receiver Puka Nacua's game status for Week 3 against the Broncos, but the Rams' head coach said he's hopeful Nacua will play.

headline: Seahawks expect Sam Darnold to practice "in some capacity" Wednesday
summary: Word over the weekend was encouraging about quarterback Sam Darnold's recovery from the glute injury that kept him from playing in Week 2 and head coach Mike Macdonald brought more good news on Monday.
